camera.guidanceHint: Fill the frame with one leaf. Hold steady. Use daylight, not flash.
camera.guidanceTitle: Hold the camera close to the leaf
camera.unavailableBody: This device did not give us a working camera. You can still choose a photo from your gallery.
dashboard.feedEmptyBody: Nothing needs your attention right now. We will tell you as soon as something does.
dashboard.mlPending: Photo checking service: not set up yet
dashboard.systemStatusHeading: What we cannot see right now
errorBoundary.body: Something went wrong on this screen. Your data is safe.
errorBoundary.title: This screen stopped working
fertilizer.timingUnknown: The source does not publish a day range for this application, so we cannot say when it falls.
history.emptyBody: Photos you check will appear here, newest first.
intro.slide1Body: Ask whether to irrigate, what the weather will do, and what your crop is worth — for your field, not a generic one.
intro.slide2Body: Photograph a leaf and get a reading with its confidence and where it came from.
intro.slide3Body: Everything you have already seen stays readable when the signal drops, marked with when it was fetched.
irrigation.harvestApproaching: This crop is close to the end of its published calendar.
irrigation.nextCheckDays_one: We will check again in {{count}} day.
irrigation.nextCheckDays_other: We will check again in {{count}} days.
irrigation.soilUncertaintyWide: The published water-holding figure for this soil is a wide range, so this estimate is less precise than the number suggests.
market.dailyAverageNote: Where several mandis reported on the same day, their modal prices are averaged into one point.
offline.bannerBody: You are seeing saved information. It will refresh when you reconnect.
offline.sessionUnverified: Signed in from your last session. Reconnect to check your account and get fresh information.
offline.writeBlocked: You need internet to save this. Try again when you reconnect.
permission.cameraBody: We open the camera only when you ask to check a crop. Photos are sent to your account and nowhere else.
permission.cameraDeniedBody: You can still check a crop by choosing a photo from your gallery, or turn the camera on in Settings.
permission.cameraTitle: Use the camera to check your crop
permission.locationBody: We use it once, to place this farm. You can type the district instead.
permission.locationDeniedBody: No problem — type the state and district instead.
recommendation.notFoundBody: It may be older than the advice we keep on this screen. Open it from your history instead.
recommendation.notFoundTitle: We could not find this advice
result.confidenceKindBAND: The AI gave a band, not a measured number.
result.confidenceKindCALIBRATED: A measured score from the model on this photo.
result.confidenceKindMATCH_SCORE: How closely your answers match this condition.
result.severityUpdated: Thank you — the severity has been worked out again with your answers.
scan.noCropsBody: Add a crop to your farm first, then you can photograph its leaves.
settings.consentBody: Share only the district, crop and result — never your name, photo or exact location.
settings.disclaimer: Advice here is guidance, not a prescription. For pesticide doses and anything you are unsure about, ask your local agriculture officer.
settings.unitsBody: Field and crop areas are shown in this unit.
symptom.reasonCROP_UNSUPPORTED: We do not have a guided check for this crop yet.
symptom.reasonDISEASE_KB_UNAVAILABLE: We have no recorded information about problems in this crop yet.
symptom.reasonKB_TAGS_UNAVAILABLE: Your answers could not be compared with what we have recorded for this crop.
symptom.reasonNO_CANDIDATE_MATCH: Nothing we have recorded matches these answers.
symptom.reasonNO_SYMPTOMS_ANSWERED: Answer at least one question so we have something to go on.
symptom.reasonREGISTRY_CROP_UNAVAILABLE: We could not load the information for this crop.
